_provenance: Hand-written summary of an IBM Bob 2.0 build session, authored for this repository. This is NOT a machine export from Bob. To substitute a real export, delete this file and replace it with the output of Bob's session export. See bob_sessions/README.md.
title: Grading Engine + Settings Store + UI
built: src/grader/grade.ts - scoring engine with weighted formula (drain 40% + critical 35% + high 25%)
calculateGrade() - maps findings + drain rate to A+ through F letter grades
saveScan() / loadHistory() - JSON timeline persistence to %APPDATA%/ecotrace/history.json
computeScoreProgress() - per-scan score deltas for timeline sparkline
src/settings.ts - ADB path + API key persistence to %APPDATA%/ecotrace/settings.json
loadSettings() / saveSettings() - reads/writes AppSettings with safe defaults
src/ui/styles.css - full dark theme (#0d0d0d bg, #00ff88 accent)
Settings modal - gear icon in vitals bar, ADB path + API key fields
bob_reasoning: Grade letter mapping uses a two-layer system: hard thresholds first (drain >= 3.0 OR criticals >= 5 = F immediately), then weighted numeric score for everything else. The settings module uses @tauri-apps/plugin-fs for all file operations - this is the correct Tauri 2.0 pattern for user-data writes. The API key field is wired as a password input that saves to settings.json. When present, it enables a second analysis phase that calls the live IBM Bob 2.0 endpoint to enrich findings with causal chains and generated fixes; local static analysis works without it.
